interest: Shows Japan's 1937 Romaji spelling reform, protests over it, and compulsory Japanese-language teaching in occupied Peiping.
overview: Docket (1910-39) on Japanese language policy: romanization queries, a Turkish alphabet-reform study, Tsingtao's shift from English to Japanese, the 1937 Romaji decree and protests, and compulsory Japanese teaching in occupied Peiping.
